title: French authorities impose partial curfews in Paris, Nice
summary: French authorities imposed curfews in towns and cities on Monday night after cost-of-living and anti-government protests descended into rioting and looting over the weekend. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Local authorities in France imposed curfews in several cities after violent protests on SaturdayImage: Camilla Baronetto/LiveMedia/ipa-agency/picture alliance

blocks.text: A turbulent weekend in France: How did it come to be?

Catherine Field, a journalist in Paris, told DW why the protests were different this time. Protesters markedly sprang up in different parts of the capital city and elsewhere, particularly taking aim at state institutions. Police appeared to have lost some sense of control, she said.
